scope: This lane owns plan orders 1-11 (the eleven generated-receipts batches). Orders 12-18 (audit-data, audit-details, audit-overview, contracts, progress, ledger, active-index) were produced in parallel by a second lane in another worktree and are not recorded here.

priorAttempt.reason: husky pre-commit hook ran `npx lint-staged`, which runs `oxfmt --write` on staged *.json files. oxfmt rewrote 6 of the 98 tracked JSON files by normalizing CRLF line endings to LF, changing their committed blob content and sha256 relative to the byte-for-byte root source copy. Per the operating instructions this is a formatter rewrite and the run must stop without pushing.

mismatchedFiles.cause: CRLF-to-LF normalization by oxfmt (delta bytes == count of CR characters in root file)

priorAttempt.note: Per operating instructions this halts the entire 18-PR run. The branch codex/roadmap-r0-publish-receipts-20260912-01-20260915 exists locally in the publish worktree with one commit (25888119eb944baf41ff23bab661fb14d9d80ac0) but was NOT pushed and no PR was created. No other branch in the plan was started. The worktree is currently checked out on this failed branch with a clean working tree (commit exists, nothing pending).

procedureNote: Second attempt used the corrected procedure: files copied then `git add`-ed BEFORE manifest generation; manifest sha256/bytes computed from git index blobs (git show :<path> / git cat-file -s :<path>), with sourceSha256 (root file hash) and, when it differs, a lineEndings note recorded per file. Post-commit verification required committed blob sha256 to equal the manifest sha256 for every file. All 11 batches passed with no unexplained mismatches (CRLF-to-LF via .gitattributes eol=lf, accepted per parent decision, and a few files already published byte-identical on main from earlier PRs).
